```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister, Parameter, ParameterVector

# Define parameters
input_params = ParameterVector('input', 8)
weight_params = ParameterVector('weight', 8)

# Create quantum register and circuit
q = QuantumRegister(4)
circuit = QuantumCircuit(q, name="VQC Circuit")

# Apply feature-encoding rotations
for i in range(4):
    circuit.ry(input_params[i], q[i])
    circuit.rz(input_params[i+4], q[i])

# Add CX gates and barrier
circuit.cx(q[0], q[2])
circuit.cx(q[1], q[3])
circuit.barrier()

# Apply ansatz rotations
circuit.ry(weight_params[0], q[0])
circuit.rz(weight_params[1], q[1])
circuit.ry(weight_params[2], q[2])
circuit.rz(weight_params[3], q[3])
circuit.rz(weight_params[4], q[0])
circuit.ry(weight_params[5], q[1])
circuit.rz(weight_params[6], q[2])
circuit.ry(weight_params[7], q[3])
```

```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

# Create quantum and classical registers
q = QuantumRegister(3)
c = ClassicalRegister(3)

# Create quantum circuit
teleport = QuantumCircuit(q, c)

# Initialize q0 with X
teleport.x(q[0])

# Create a Bell pair on q1 and q2 with H and CX
teleport.barrier()
teleport.h(q[1])
teleport.cx(q[1], q[2])

# Apply Alice’s CX(q0,q1) and H(q0)
teleport.barrier()
teleport.cx(q[0], q[1])
teleport.h(q[0])

# Measure q0 and q1 into c0 and c1
teleport.barrier()
teleport.measure(q[0], c[0])
teleport.measure(q[1], c[1])

# Apply CX(q1,q2) and CZ(q0,q2)
teleport.barrier()
teleport.cx(q[1], q[2])
teleport.cz(q[0], q[2])

# Measure q2 into c2
teleport.barrier()
teleport.measure(q[2], c[2])

print(teleport.draw())
```

```python
c = ClassicalRegister(3)
```

```python
qc.h(q[1])

qc.cu1(math.pi/2, q[0], q[2])
qc.cu1(math.pi/4, q[1], q[2])

qc.cu1(-math.pi/2, q[0], q[2])
qc.cu1(-math.pi/4, q[0], q[1])
qc.h(q[0])
qc.h(q[1])
qc.h(q[2])

# Measure all qubits
qc.measure(q[0], c[0])
qc.measure(q[1], c[1])
qc.measure(q[2], c[2])
```

```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

# Create quantum and classical registers
q = QuantumRegister(3)
c = ClassicalRegister(3)

# Create quantum circuit
teleport = QuantumCircuit(q, c)

# Create a Bell pair on qubits 1 and 2
teleport.h(q[1])
teleport.cx(q[1], q[2])

# Put qubit 0 into a Hadamard state
teleport.h(q[0])

# Perform the Bell-basis steps on qubits 0 and 1
teleport.barrier()
teleport.cx(q[0], q[1])
teleport.h(q[0])

# Measure qubits 0 and 1 into classical bits 0 and 1
teleport.measure(q[0], c[0])
teleport.measure(q[1], c[1])

# Apply CX from qubit 1 to 2 and CZ from qubit 0 to 2
teleport.cx(q[1], q[2])
teleport.cz(q[0], q[2])

# Measure qubit 2 into classical bit 2
teleport.measure(q[2], c[2])

print(teleport.draw())
```
